text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the practice match, two Umamusume walk home together with troubled expressions.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: The first time we raced them, I thought they were pushovers, but… they were really something else today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Team Zenith won the practice match, but only by a hair, proving how far our team has come since the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And while it's good to have her back, Director Akikawa has decided to merely observe Ms. Kashimoto's methods without taking any action.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The status quo remains unchanged at the academy, and the days pass steeped in anxiety and uncertainty…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: What could the director be thinking? What's going to happen to our school?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! We'll be okay!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: All we gotta do is win the Unity Cup. Right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our spirits thus lifted, we get back to training in earnest.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Fuku, you're so close to breaking your record! Go, go, go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nnngh! L-lucky daaash!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unbeknownst to us, someone is watching us as we train.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I feel so much more motivated when I'm with them! They're the best team I could ever ask for!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Hmm… She feels more motivated just because she's in a team?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Fancy seeing you here, Little Cocon!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: The same thing you're doing. Scouting out the competition. I'd hate to be caught off guard when it's time to face off against them.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh…

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: The main impression I get is that they're the complete opposite of us. Always cheering each other on and stuff…

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: The things they see as strengths are things that our team has deliberately avoided… It makes me wonder who's really in the right.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Anyway, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Little Cocon averts her gaze at Bitter Glasse's question.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: There's nothing wrong with Trainer Kashimoto's program. We've improved a lot thanks to her.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Yet despite all their messing around and not taking things seriously…

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: This lot has improved far more than we have.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Yeah…

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: I was trying to figure out what exactly they have that we don't, but…

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: You couldn't come up with an answer?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: It's not that I couldn't—I just didn't want to believe what it was…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Little Cocon lifts her face, her brows creased with concern.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Crap, they're coming this way. Let's beat it.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Hmm… So you're saying we've unconsciously put caps on our own potential?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: In short, yes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Little Cocon sighs quietly.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: We have faith in Trainer Kashimoto's detailed training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: But because we believe in it so wholeheartedly, we've fooled ourselves into thinking that simply following her program will be enough to make us stronger.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: In contrast, the other team was able to overcome their limits because they lost before. They work hard for the sake of their teammates.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Huh… So it's more of a joint effort for them, eh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bitter Glasse falls silent for a while, then looks at Little Cocon with a gleam in her eye.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Why don't we try copying them and start training together as a team too, then?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: There's no way that would work. First of all, I don't consider any of you "friends."

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Haha! Ouch, that's harsh! All right, then what do you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Well… I don't think it's just me. Going above and beyond for the sake of "friendship" doesn't seem like our style, does it?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: But… we might just be able to push our limits if it's for Trainer Kashimoto's sake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day after this conversation, Team Zenith holds a secret meeting at the stress stump.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Everyone's been brought up to speed, right? And we're all in agreement?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing her teammates nod with solemn expressions, Little Cocon takes out a notebook.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Its pages are filled with meticulously recorded details of past training sessions, including their dates and improvements made in each one.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: If we're going to expand on Trainer Kashimoto's program, I figured we need to fully understand it first, so I did my own analysis.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Turns out it's more detailed than I realized. She's been adjusting the intensity of every session based on everyone's condition and progress.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: I always knew that Trainer Kashimoto was special, but I can't believe how meticulous all her calculations are…

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: The more I learn about her, the more amazed I am by how skilled she is at managing us—how deeply she understands us!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The rest of the team nod in agreement at Bitter Glasse's words.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: But we have to shatter her preconceptions of what she thinks is our 100% and work until we reach 120% of our potential!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: So long as we remain trapped within the realm of her expectations, we'll never achieve anything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Team Zenith begins their secret training the next day.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff! Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Phew, it's tough to do extra training after a busy day… My legs are so heavy, and I'm sleepy…

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Cut the complaining. I bet you have enough energy to run another lap or two, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Course I do!
